AX-FREQUENCY.question: what DOES the countable capture — the squeeze on the household (SHACKLES) or the civic fabric holding them (BONDS)?

poles.SHACKLES: negative-freedom dimension: household-debt composition (medical per-zip, student per-county), education-and-healthcare costs/access = the two-forms-of-shackles = the modern-day-indentured-servitude [Certain — founder-verbatim, working-notes.md THE SHACKLES-VEIN]; the economic-bleed to lenders = the macro-arithmetic made countable
poles.BONDS: community-attachment infrastructure: the decomposition's winning carriers (libraries, parks) promoted from care_components, plus civic-org density and the afterschool/sports/attachment program evidence [Certain — framing; civic-org route [Guess]]

AX-LOCATION.question: WHERE does the countable live — in the present-availability of the thing (ACCESS) or in the shape over time (TIME-ARC, t+0/t+1/t+2 as columns, not re-runs)?

poles.ACCESS: static per-capita availability: providers-per-capita, insurance-coverage-%, transit-reachability, facilities/civic-infra present on the ground in the city-year [Certain — structure; routes need verification pass]
poles.TIME-ARC: the lag-structure as a first-class panel column: every series returns t+0/t+1/t+2 in one run; the arc stops being a lesson and becomes a datatype [Certain — design; machinery proven via bookings facility file]
